name: Lucía Fernández García
title: Junior Android Developer
summary: Junior Android Developer with hands-on experience building and maintaining mobile features for consumer-facing apps. Strong foundation in Kotlin, Jetpack components, and clean code practices, with a focus on delivering stable user experiences and collaborating effectively in Agile teams.

bullets: Developed 6+ UI screens in Jetpack Compose, improving feature delivery speed by 25% for a customer-facing app.
Implemented API integrations with Retrofit and Coroutines, reducing loading errors by 18% in key user flows.
Fixed 40+ bugs and supported release stabilization, contributing to a 4.6-star app rating on Google Play.
Assisted in building reusable UI components with XML and ViewBinding, cutting duplicate code across 3 modules.
Added local persistence features with Room for offline access, supporting over 10,000 monthly active users.
Participated in code reviews and sprint planning, consistently meeting delivery goals across 2-week Agile iterations.
Supported development of an internal Android tool used by 200+ employees for incident tracking and reporting.
Created and tested minor feature updates under senior supervision, improving task completion time by 15%.
Documented setup and troubleshooting steps, helping reduce onboarding time for new interns by 30%.
Executed Android test cases on 15+ app builds, identifying and reporting UI and functional regressions early.
Collaborated with developers to reproduce defects and verify fixes, lowering re-opened tickets by 12%.
Maintained test evidence and release notes, improving traceability during pre-release validation.

education.degree: Higher Technician Diploma in Multi-platform Application Development
